Based on the documentation, Hermes automatically sends `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}` on OpenAI-compatible streaming requests to populate `/usage` statistics.

To ensure Hermes properly treats your LocalAI backend as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, make sure your configuration explicitly sets `provider: custom` under your model configuration:

```yaml
model:
  default: <your-model-name>
  provider: custom
  base_url: https://localai.example.internal/v1
fallback_providers: []
```

Setting `provider: custom` ensures Hermes does not misroute requests or fall back to defaults, allowing standard OpenAI-compatible streaming behavior (including usage chunk tracking) to function.
